# External Dataset Staging

Place downloaded public datasets here. This directory is gitignored.

## Example

```text
datasets/external/
├── leadata/
│   └── (downloaded LeaData images and metadata)
└── fabricnet/
    └── (downloaded FabricNET images and metadata)
```

Do not commit dataset images. See [dataset-storage-policy.md](../../docs/datasets/dataset-storage-policy.md).
